summary: Added a local-first AgentOS artifact registry fixture and deterministic agent_core ecosystem resolver.
acceptance_evidence: agent_core::ecosystem::LocalRegistrySnapshot loads a pinned local snapshot from file or JSON.
agent_core::ecosystem::EcosystemResolver resolves requested artifacts and dependencies into a deterministic EcosystemLockV1.
Resolver returns network_required=false and refuses network source URIs in local-only mode.
Resolver fails closed for revoked artifacts, missing dependencies, digest mismatch and incompatible runtime versions.
Rootfs fixture includes policy-pack, workflow-pack and test-replay-pack entries with file:// sources.

commands.summary: agent_core 99, agentd 56, runtime_contracts 20 and security_execution 75 tests passed.
No live network registry URI is present in the fixture.

blocked_shortcuts: Resolver does not fetch live network data.
Resolver does not stage or activate artifacts.
Revoked, missing, incompatible or digest-mismatched artifacts cannot resolve as valid.
optional_dependencies: Missing optional host features are reported as degraded optional features and do not authorize host mutation.
promotion_impact: Enables aom local search/show/verify/stage work to build on deterministic local artifact resolution without adding network or activation authority.
